lines: Go to Pharaoh. The man who wanted him dead. The man he had run from.
Musa did not refuse. But he knew his weakness, and he asked his Lord for help:
"My Lord, expand for me my chest. And ease for me my task. And untie the knot from my tongue, so they may understand my speech."
"And appoint for me a helper from my family: Harun, my brother."
And Allah gave him everything he asked for.
Then He told them both: "Speak to him with gentle speech, that perhaps he may be reminded, or fear."
Gentle words... to the worst tyrant on earth. If Allah asked for gentleness with Pharaoh, how gently should we speak to each other?
They were afraid. And Allah said: "Fear not. Indeed, I am with you both. I hear, and I see."
